text:
emily: OK folks, quick sync on QuickStart Garden (mini-refapp) launch plan. Goal: launch post + 20m webinar + benchmark blog. Timeline: next Wed. :calendar:

sam: love it. Audience: product-engineers and OSS folks. Focus on easy starter flows + perf numbers.

matt: we can get 2 small benchmarks (local vs hosted) by Tue EOD. Will need datasets and prompts.

lia: I'll draft launch post + webinar outline. Can someone drop the UTM scheme?

zane: use `?utm_source=refapp&utm_campaign=qs_garden_launch&utm_medium=email` and add `utm_content=webinar|post|snippet` depending. I'll set event tracking.

sam: landing page URL: https://tiny.redwood/qs-garden

emily: copy checklist: 1) launch post 2) benchmark writeup 3) webinar slides + demo 4) inbound routing 5) social snippets

lia: rough copy ETA Tue noon. Matt, can you record a 6-min demo clip for the webinar?

matt: yes, will do Wed morning. I'll record screen + CLI: `rwd deploy --model llama2` snippet.

zane: inbound routing: webhook -> HubSpot -> tag 'qs_garden' -> SDR queue #oss-inbound

sam: can we make a short signup flow: name/email/company + checkbox 'interested in dedicated/private'? keeps leads qualified.

emily: assign owners: post=lia, benchmarks=matt+sam, webinar=sam+lia, tracking=zane, socials=me

lia: social hooks: short code examples, 1 screenshot, & benchmark highlight (e.g., 3x cost reduction). Need numbers from Matt.

matt: initial numbers: local quantized run ~= 0.8x cost of hosted, with caching -> 3x cost reduction vs naive. I'll provide a CSV.

sam: we'll run a dry run of the webinar Monday 4pm PT. Invite list: OSS community + early adopters.

emily: ok! action items in the doc: https://tiny.redwood/qs-garden-plan (please add comments)

deploy-bot: Reminder: webinar calendar event created by emily for 2026-03-30 16:00 PT :bell:

lia: noted. I'll post draft in #marketing by Tue 12:30. :eyes:

zane: test tracking after post goes up, I'll validate UTM and HubSpot mapping.

emily: great. small ask: keep messaging simple — 'QuickStart Garden: spin up a refapp in 5 mins with low-cost inference' that's our headline.

sam: +1. short demo, clear CTA, signup + demo code sample.

matt: done. uploading benchmark CSV to the doc now.

lia: thanks team. wrapping up.
